 Within Pali literature, automated text-reuse analysis identifies extensive formulaic overlaps across canonical and commentarial works, yielding 60 matching passages across 14 texts [DharmaNexus]. The most substantial correspondence is with the first volume of the commentary to the *Theragāthā* (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*), which shares 32 passages (notably the sequence spanning segments 1.1–5.3) [DharmaNexus].
